title: Shopify POS vs. Clover & Square: Why Multi-Location Retailers Are Switching
summary: Compare Shopify POS vs Square & Clover for multi-store retail. Discover how to sync inventory, offer local pickup, and switch with zero downtime.
body_markdown:
Running a retail business across two, three, or five locations is hard enough. But when your point-of-sale system acts like every store lives on a different planet, everyday operations quickly turn into a headache.


If you're using **Square** or **Clover** , you've probably hit the ceiling: mismatched stock levels, separate systems for your physical shop and website, and clunky workarounds just to see what’s selling where.


Here is why multi-location shop owners are ditching Clover and Square for **Shopify POS** —and what it actually takes to make the switch without closing your doors or losing sales.


### The Real Cost Breakdown: Processing, Hardware, and Hidden Add-ons


On paper, Square and Clover look cheap to set up. But as you open more locations and grow your online presence, those costs creep up fast.


**Expense Category** **Square** **Clover** **Shopify POS**


**Software Fees**


Free tier gets expensive fast once you add Advanced Retail features per device.


Monthly fees stack per device, plus paid apps for basic functions like loyalty.


Flat rate per location for Shopify POS Pro, unlocking deep multi-store features.


**Card Processing**


Flat rate pricing that eats into margins as your sales volume grows.


Varies by merchant processor; often hidden fees and lock-in contracts.


Competitive rates with integrated Shop Pay, plus lower rates on higher-tier Shopify plans.


**E-Commerce Sync**


Web sync feels like an afterthought; limited custom options.


Requires third-party middleware or expensive apps to sync with online carts.


**Native.** One system runs your physical counters and online checkout out of the box.


- **The Takeaway:** Square charges you for basic scale, and Clover locks you into third-party app subscriptions. Shopify POS centralizes your software costs into one predictable monthly bill.


### The Functional Gap: Where Square and Clover Fall Short


#### 1. Centralized Multi-Location Inventory


- **Square & Clover:** Managing inventory across 3+ stores usually means logging into separate dashboards, running manual stock transfers, or constantly explaining to customers why an item listed as "in stock" isn't actually there.


- **Shopify POS:** Real-time stock visibility across every store and warehouse. If Store A is low on a jacket, your staff can sell it off Store B's rack right from their iPad and ship it directly to the customer's home.


#### 2. Buy Online, Pick Up In-Store (BOPIS)


- **Square & Clover:** Setting up curbside or local pickup across multiple locations requires clunky workarounds or extra software plugins that break during peak sales days.


- **Shopify POS:** Native BOPIS. Customers select their closest store at checkout, your store staff gets an instant pick-and-pack alert on their POS screen, and the inventory holds automatically.


#### 3. One Unified Customer Profile


- **Square & Clover:** A customer buys in store #1, buys online, and then visits store #2. In your backend, they look like three completely different people with three different loyalty point balances.


- **Shopify POS:** One master profile. Your team can view a customer's entire order history—online order returns included—no matter which door they walk through.
